now-sdk explain [topic]

Display documentation for a Fluent SDK topic

Parameters:
  topic  Topic name or keyword to search for                            [string]

Options:
  -d, --debug    Print debug output                   [boolean] [default: false]
  -l, --list     List topics. Combine with a topic to filter (e.g., --list flow)
                                                                       [boolean]
      --format   Output format: "pretty" for terminal, "raw" for plain markdown
                                  [choices: "pretty", "raw"] [default: "pretty"]
  -p, --peek     Show a brief summary instead of the full document     [boolean]
  -h, --help     Show help                                             [boolean]
  -v, --version  Show version number                                   [boolean]
